contracts.name: FeedMessage
contracts.text: transit_realtime.FeedMessage (GTFS-rt protobuf): entity[] each carrying tripUpdate { trip, stopTimeUpdate[] } and/or vehicle { trip, stopId, currentStatus }

contracts.name: RenderSnapshot
contracts.text: { asOf: EpochMs, trips: TripState[] } — TripState { tripId, routeId, direction, lastKnownStop: { stopId, at }, upcoming: StopArrival[], status: "progressing" | "stalled" }

contracts.name: TrainPose[]
contracts.text: Per-rAF interpolated positions handed to networkLayer.setTrains — one pose per live Trip on its Track segment

nodes.annotation: FeedPoller.alarm() fires (worker/src/index.ts:135). Loads TripMemory (cross-poll history) from DO storage.
Promise.allSettled over the 8 GTFS-rt feed URLs (worker/src/poll.ts:32). Fan-out and barrier: 8 fetches in flight at once; control resumes only when every one has settled.
Guard: zero successful feeds -> pollSnapshot returns null and the caller keeps the last good KV frame (poll.ts:44, index.ts:140).
Total outage: no write this cycle; memory left un-pruned so the outage does not forget every trip.
transit_realtime.FeedMessage.decode(buf) per fulfilled response (poll.ts:40): protobuf bytes -> FeedMessage.
Per-entity guard: needs tripUpdate.trip and nyct.isAssigned — live tracked trains only (worker/src/reshape.ts:96-100).
Entity skipped: not an assigned trip.
Per-trip guard: stop times without a usable arrival/departure keyframe are dropped; a trip with zero arrivals is skipped (reshape.ts:106-116).
Trip skipped: nothing renderable.
Branch on motion (reshape.ts:150-179): observed STOPPED_AT / approaching from a known departed stop / committed arrival overrun by >45s.
Observed AT the front stop: anchor there, glide toward the stops ahead.
Dead-reckon the departed->front segment; arrival to front sent fresh each poll so the client bends pace instead of snapping.
Stalled: runway truncated at the front stop so the client holds the train there and blinks.
The merged frame across all 8 feeds: { asOf, trips }.
SNAPSHOT.put('trips:snapshot', JSON.stringify(snap)) (worker/src/index.ts:141). A write: nothing meaningful comes back.
finally: setAlarm(now + 30s) re-arms the loop unconditionally (index.ts:146). Control leaves the drawn system until the next alarm.
poll() on load, then every 30s (web/src/main.ts:776-777).
fetch('/api/trips'). The worker serves the KV blob verbatim and kicks the poller awake, fire-and-forget (worker/src/index.ts:38-62).
clockSkew = snapshot.asOf - Date.now() (main.ts:742): rebase onto the worker clock so the re-base time matches the frame loop.
estimator.ingest(snapshot, tracks, now + skew) (web/src/trains.ts:339): forward-only reconciliation — fromDist clamped so a revised ETA bends the remaining pace, never snaps position back.
Interpolated poses, recomputed per requestAnimationFrame.
frame(): networkLayer.setTrains(poses) (main.ts:761-764). Control leaves to the GPU layer; the train moves on screen.
